cards.title: Homepage

problems: Everyone who taps “Website” on your Google listing lands on a page that says “This domain is for sale.”

Your 50 Google reviews appear on no page of yours.
fixes: A headline that says HVAC company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Your number one tap away, with your address and hours.
Every service you do, with your customers' words beside it.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

fixes: A page for AC repair in Wichita, KS, with repair costs against replacement.
Reviews from these jobs beside each point.

onboardingQuestions: Owner's name and surname, and whether they want it on the site. No source names the owner.
Founding year. The earliest Google review is from December 2017, but no founding year is confirmed.
Licensed and insured? Licence number and insurer to show.
Brands sold and installed, and dealer status. No manufacturer locator confirmed one (Carrier checked, Trane not).
Warranties on labor and equipment, financing, and whether estimates are free. None are on the site.
Maintenance plan or tune-up membership: is one sold, or are checkups booked one at a time?
Service area: which towns around Wichita, and how far from 67204. The site says Wichita only.
Hours: confirm Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and whether they offer after-hours or weekend service.
Geothermal: confirm they service it (one review). Commercial or hangar work: is there a line?
What happened to firstcallheatingcooling.com, and do they want the domain back?
Email address to show, plus Facebook or other pages and who controls them.
Logo files, brand colors and job photos.
